scope: Only memory is Go. The C bus and external host/storage owners stay C. This ledger classifies, and does not weaken, the immutable broad native inventory.

go-owner.contract: memory data, command and runtime stages; existing C bus framing
go-owner.reason: Native implementation retired. Go owns domain policy and all module-side communication. Intentional retrieval differences are recorded separately from language conformance.
go-owner.cutover_dependency: Completed: Go owner registered in both placements; the production and fixture callers use its declared stages.

host-transport.contract: Authenticated host requests, complete owner envelopes, explicit owner refusal
host-transport.reason: Host owns authentication, store selection, module lifecycle and transport. It calls the Go owner and never substitutes a native engine.
host-transport.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

kb-client.owner: C KB client used by external hosts
kb-client.contract: memory.* request/reply protocol, local Go screening, host activation receipts
kb-client.reason: Only marshals remote requests, parses protocol fields and records host-owned receipts. Admission, scope eligibility, search, composition and rendering are Go operations. Older fixed-record clients remain only for external ABI consumers; live text paths use complete owner output.
kb-client.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

host-context.owner: C session/agent host consuming Go projections
host-context.contract: Go session views and ingress assembly, caller-supplied space budget
host-context.reason: C retains non-memory session/agent behavior. Go chooses, ranks and renders memory sections and diagnostic previews. C appends returned text and records externally owned retrieval events.
host-context.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

benchmark-transport.contract: Versioned memory-stage calls; injected production Go evaluator
benchmark-transport.reason: Three retained memory_insert entry points are benchmark-host transport only. No scratch memory engine or local ranking implementation remains.
benchmark-transport.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

storage-protocol.owner: KB persisted graph contracts; PostgreSQL connection provider
storage-protocol.contract: KB-owned persisted enum/row definitions and PostgreSQL session protocol
storage-protocol.reason: Persisted relation codes and KB domain declarations remain with KB. PostgreSQL alone opens production store connections. The retired DB2 process and wire catalog are removed; their principal and event IDs remain reserved. Go memory owns memory domain operations.
storage-protocol.cutover_dependency: Completed: PostgreSQL is the sole database provider for both placements; memory boundary checks prohibit a native memory fallback.

protocol-catalog.contract: MCP tools, served CLI/HTTP routes and generated schemas
protocol-catalog.reason: Memory names are command/schema identifiers, not a native implementation. Runtime routing uses the declared Go stages.
protocol-catalog.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

host-fixture.contract: C harnesses for the existing bus, transport and storage interfaces
host-fixture.reason: C tests exercise external C owners. Native memory domain parity is tested in Go. Test-only stubs supply protocol replies, not a shipping fallback.
host-fixture.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

legacy-fixture.owner: Legacy test inventory; excluded from acceptance
legacy-fixture.contract: Unbuilt historical monolith tests tracked by check_tests_are_run
legacy-fixture.reason: These are unbuilt mixed-owner historical fixtures, not production consumers or passing evidence. Their memory behaviors are covered by the Go owner suites; they cannot satisfy a G0 gate.
legacy-fixture.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

legacy-command.contract: CMD_SRCS compile-only registration; shipping CLI uses served commands
legacy-command.reason: Not linked into a shipping CLI or Server command table. Retained mixed-purpose commands call transport APIs; the complete cmd_memory family and its fixtures are deleted.
legacy-command.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

retired-api.reason: No native production definition remains. The implementation is Go or the dead entry point is deleted; any surviving type/declaration is separately classified under its external protocol owner.
retired-api.cutover_dependency: Completed: this external owner is outside the memory module; the module-only and native-boundary gates prohibit a native fallback.

credential-custody.contract: Alternative memory bearer sealed through existing generic first-boot custody
credential-custody.reason: The added token name is credential transport, not memory storage or retrieval logic.
credential-custody.cutover_dependency: Vault custody precedes memory startup; egress reads the credential through its existing helper.
